## Intent — what this is for

Session 3 (T3.3, second half); Design §S3 + Integration points ("the artifacts system (share)")

## Done when

POST /api/chat/sessions/{session}/share creates a `markdown` artifact whose body is session_export.render_markdown's output VERBATIM (one redactor, two callers — `_redact` promoted to the public `redact_field`), readonly=True, tagged shared-chat, with the source chat + redacted recorded on the creation event; NativeArtifactProvider.update / update_binary / revert refuse a readonly artifact in the STORE (so the MCP tools and workflow actions hit the same wall as the route) while delete stays allowed; restricted (incognito/temporary) chats are refused 403 while export still works; the ChatHistory row menu carries "Share as read-only artifact" beside the two Export items and lands the user on the created artifact; ArtifactViewer/ArtifactsSection read `readonly` so no refused affordance is offered; never auto-published, proven by an AST census of every share_session call site in src/personalclaw plus a poisoned-source test proving the census can fail. NOT a publish: no public URL, no share token, no auth bypass — external exposure stays EXTERNAL-ACCESS's decision. Shipped 2026-08-11 (dashboard/session_share.py, tests/test_session_share.py, 22 cases); reference regenerated (632→633 agent-callable routes).
